title: 🔋 Motorola Edge 70 Neo: The Price at Last and Sales Start 1 December… Full Specs and Snapdragon 7s Gen 3!
body: 🔋 Motorola Edge 70 Neo: The Price at Last and Sales Start 1 December… Full Specs and Snapdragon 7s Gen 3!
Motorola has announced the full price of the Edge 70 Neo and its sale date today, after the earlier teaser had revealed only the battery, display, and camera, with no price.
The price is 40,999 rupees for the only version, with 8 GB of RAM and 128 GB of storage, and with launch offers the effective price drops to 34,999 rupees.
Sales begin on 1 December at noon on Flipkart, Motorola's website, and retail stores in India.
The phone runs on the Snapdragon 7s Gen 3 processor, with LPDDR5X memory and UFS 3.1 storage, and external memory up to 1 TB.
It comes with a 2 MP macro camera and a 32 MP front camera, with 4K video recording on both cameras, in addition to the 50 MP main camera revealed earlier.
It supports 7.5 W wired reverse charging, and charging while gaming without going through the battery to protect it, along with 45 W fast charging and the charger in the box.
It runs Android 16 with the Hello UX interface, with a promise of three system updates and security updates until 2031.
It has IP64 resistance, MIL-STD-810H testing, and Gorilla Glass 7i, and comes in four colors whose names are now announced: Mountain View, Gray Lilac, Milky Blue, and Sage.

Simply put: the teaser revealed the huge battery and the bright display, but today the picture is complete: the price, the processor, the operating system, and the sale date; a mid-range phone with a clear price and a long update promise.
Would you buy a phone with a 7,000 mAh battery at this price?
